payload.name: Expand collection enumeration searches
payload.description: Use when a question asks what items a person collects or gathers; expand search vocabulary beyond 'collect' and enumerate all named collectible items from preference and event memories.
content: If a question asks what items a person collects or gathers, do not query only with 'collect(s)'. Also run supplementary searches using '<person> collection', '<person> hobbies', '<person> interests', '<person> likes', '<person> enjoys', and '<person> favorite'.

If a retrieved memory mentions a specific collectible category (e.g., jerseys, DVDs, shoes, memorabilia) or a related hobby/media interest, search for that item term with the person's name before finalizing.

Before answering, enumerate all distinct named collectible items from preference and event memories, and if the retrieved set seems incomplete (e.g., only one item for a plural 'items' question), run at least one additional vocabulary-expanded search.

solves: A verb-only 'collect' search missed equally valid 'collection', 'enjoys', or hobby/media phrasings, yielding an incomplete item list. The mechanism is a lexical gap: enumeration questions need vocabulary-expanded, exhaustive preference-memory searching. Applies to any future question asking what items a person collects/gathers; not to count questions or single-item factoids.
